notes.title: Release of Episode 3
notes.content: Today, we’re excited to release Episode 3 of Foresight, bringing the series to its conclusion.

notes.title: Episode 2 release
notes.content: Added an entire second episode of gameplay to this update. More then double the amount of game that was present before. Also include several updates and patches to optimize gameplay.

notes.title: Final launch patch
notes.content: Update prior to final launch. Includes some graphics and mechanics updates.
